how_its_made:
The aim of the project is to Create, manage, trade and merge AI context as INFTs on 0G network to be consumed by OpenClaw agents, using 0G compute and 0G storage. The project aimed to protect users from data surveillance when using the '"big tech' clouds through the use of 0G compute network, but still have a need to use private data in context of LLM.

I used OpenClaw inside docker on a vps for security.
I used 0G for the decentralized compute and storage.
Unfortunately, I did not have the time to complete this project during the hackathon weekend.
